name: Shounen Wolf
source:
"This is the record of my time spent with the Boy Wolf--the child said to be raised by wolves."

Biologist Ozaki Yuusuke visits a small town in a foreign country where the Boy Wolf is said to live.  He has come to find out if the story is true.
translation:
“这是我与少年狼——那个据说是被狼群抚养长大的孩子——共度时光的记录。”
生物学家尾崎佑介前往一个据说少年狼居住的外国小镇。他来此是为了查明这个故事是否属实。
